definitions.explanation: a reference work containing articles on various subjects or specialized fields

examples.japanese: {百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I looked it up in an encyclopedia.

examples.japanese: ウィキペディア⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧{百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}だ。
⟦{子供|こども}{向|む}け→子供向け：17933_kodomomuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an encyclopedia for children.

notes:
{百科|ひゃっか} literally means 'hundred subjects' — ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (hundred) + {科|か} (branch/subject). It refers to comprehensive, wide-ranging knowledge.

COMPOUNDS:
- {百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}: encyclopedia (the standard compound)
- {百科|ひゃっか}{全書|ぜんしょ}: comprehensive encyclopedia/compendium
- {大百科|だいひゃっか}: great encyclopedia

USAGE:
{百科|ひゃっか} rarely appears alone — it almost always appears in the compound {百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}. Note: the kanji ⟦{事典|じてん}→事典：21891_jiten⟧ (reference work) is different from ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ (dictionary), though both are read じてん.

NOTABLE ENCYCLOPEDIAS:
- {世界大百科事典|せかいだいひゃっかじてん}: World Encyclopedia
- ブリタニカ{百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}: Encyclopædia Britannica
